messages.subject: leaflet and shiny
parts:
Hi!
I try this example with in shiny which work perfectly (with help of Yihui) and I want to use input$carte_popup_mouseover. How can I use this in server.r? There is no example in http://rstudio.github.io/leaflet

## ui.r
library(shiny)
library(leaflet)
library(shinythemes)


shinyUI(

  bootstrapPage(theme = shinytheme("united"),

    tags$head(tags$style("html,body {width:100%;height:100%}
.floater { background-color: white; padding: 8px; opacity: 0.7; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); }
  ")),

  leafletOutput("carte",width = "100%", height = "100%"),

    absolutePanel(
      right = 30, top = 10, width = 200, class = "floater",
      selectInput("degre", label = h3("Selection de niveau:"),
                  choices = list("Jardin","Primaire","Collège","Lycée"),selected = "Jardin")
    ),
  absolutePanel(
    right = 30, top = 280, style = "", class = "floater",

    h4("Info sur l'établissement"),
    uiOutput("Info")
  )

  )
)

##server.r

library(shiny)
library(leaflet)
library(rgdal)

shinyServer(function(input, output,session) {

output$carte<-renderLeaflet({
  if(is.null(input$degre)){return()}
  data<-reactive({
    switch(input$degre,
           "Jardin"=jardin,
           "Primaire"=primaire,
           "Collège"=college,
           "Lycée"=lycee)
  })
 couleur<-switch(input$degre,
           "Jardin"="tomato",
           "Primaire"="skyblue",
           "Collège"="limegreen",
           "Lycée"="steelblue")

 leaflet(carto)%>%addTiles()%>%
  addPolygons(
    weight=2,
    opacity=1,
    color='white',
    smoothFactor=0.5,
    dashArray='3',
    fillOpacity=0.7) %>%addCircleMarkers(~data()$LONGITUDE,~data()$LATITUDE,radius=1.5,color=couleur,popup=~paste0("<strong>Infrastructure: </strong>",data()$INFRASTRUCTURE,"<br><strong>Localité: </strong>",data()$LOCALITE,"<br><strong>Statut: </strong>",data()$STATUT))

     })

})

##global.r
library(rgdal)
jardin<-read.csv2("data/jardin.csv",header=T,sep=";")
primaire<-read.csv2("data/primaire.csv",header=T,sep=";")
college<-read.csv2("data/college.csv",header=T,sep=";")
lycee<-read.csv2("data/lycee.csv",header=T,sep=";")

carto<-readOGR("data","TGO_l05_2012")

Merci d'avance!!!!

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: leaflet and shiny
parts:
I don't think input$carte_popup_mouseover works when the popups are
added through addCircleMarkers(). It only works when you addPopups()
separately, otherwise I think you should use
input$carte_marker_mouseover.

BTW, you can actually simplify your code by using the `data` argument
of addXXX(), e.g.

addCircleMarkers(
data = ~data(), radius = 1.5, color = couleur,
popup = ~paste0("<strong>Infrastructure: </strong>", INFRASTRUCTURE,
"<br><strong>Localité: </strong>", LOCALITE,
"<br><strong>Statut: </strong>", STATUT)
)

i.e. you don't need to type data()$XXX everywhere. See
http://rstudio.github.io/leaflet/map_widget.html

Regards,
Yihui
